source_tiers.description: Current NosTale client data supplied by the user machine; preferred for version-accurate game data.
Official or first-party online documentation/API when a machine-readable endpoint is available.
Public community APIs/providers with explicit provenance and version metadata.
Public community repositories used only as versioned fallback/reference data.
Human-readable technical references used for schema/semantics, never as a silent replacement for missing authoritative records.

verified_sources.notes: Public NosTale data-provider project. Endpoint availability must be discovered/configured before use; do not invent API URLs.
Supports inspection/unpacking of NosTale client data containers and recognized NSgtdData records.
Technical reference for NosTale data-file formats; use for validation and field semantics.
Archived historical data. Never treat it as current live-game truth; use only when explicitly versioned and marked as legacy.
